players.product: AI data-center colocation (Tydal, Norway: 121 IT MW leased to Volta for NVIDIA GPUs) and Bitdeer AI GPU cloud (NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 / Vera Rubin capacity in Malaysia, Norway and the US)

quarterly_data.quarter: Bitdeer Technologies press release: Bitdeer Announces July 2026 Production and Operations Update (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: July 2026 update: Bitdeer AI completed the procurement of 66 NVIDIA GB300 systems; contract discussions for the A201 facility (21.7MW IT load) are underway. Company: 'Demand is keen and strong. We expect to sign the contracts of A201 capacity and start collecting the advance payments within a month. We foresee the pricing of AI Cloud to increase further in the short-term future.' Tydal, Norway lease: the tenant is a subsidiary of Volta, and the entire 121 IT MW will be configured to run NVIDIA GPUs for the end customer, a leading AI lab (not named).
quarterly_data.figure: 66 NVIDIA GB300 systems procured; A201 21.7MW in contract discussions
